title: What Does Context Compression Cost an Agent? Interaction Costs Unrevealed by Task-Completion Metrics
abstract: arXiv:2608.16370v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Task completion is the standard metric for evaluating context compression, yet it is incomplete: compression can increase an agent's interaction cost by forcing it to reacquire dropped state while leaving completion statistically unchanged.   We introduce a controlled runtime measurement protocol for reacquisition cost in a bounded-horizon tool-using agent. The agent acts in a deterministic planning environment under a fixed 24-turn horizon. We vary compression severity, compare a dropping operator with a fact-preserving operator, restore dropped state through controlled oracle interventions, and decompose tool calls into retrieval and execution. We evaluate three models across two task regimes.   Retrieval calls increase in all six model-regime comparisons and account for almost all added interaction; five of six remain significant after Holm correction. translated_title: 上下文压缩对智能体有何代价？任务完成指标未揭示的交互成本
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.16370v1 公告类型：新 摘要：任务完成度是评估上下文压缩的标准指标，但它并不全面：压缩可能通过迫使智能体重新获取被丢弃的状态来增加其交互成本，而统计上的完成度却保持不变。我们引入了一种受控的运行时测量协议，用于在有限步数工具使用智能体中量化重新获取成本。该智能体在固定24回合的确定性规划环境中运行。我们改变压缩强度，比较丢弃操作符与保留事实的操作符，通过受控的预言机干预恢复被丢弃的状态，并将工具调用分解为检索和执行。我们评估了三种模型在两种任务场景下的表现。检索调用在所有六种模型-场景比较中均增加，且几乎占据了所有新增交互；其中五种在霍尔姆校正后仍然显著。在预设的5倍比较点上，完成度变化在所有情况下均不显著。
tldr: 本文揭示了上下文压缩虽不影响任务完成度，但会显著增加智能体的交互成本（主要是检索调用），表明任务完成度指标不足以全面评估压缩效果。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that context compression, while leaving task completion unchanged, significantly increases an agent's interaction cost (mainly retrieval calls), showing that task-completion metrics are insufficient for evaluating compression.
